title: Core Config
warning: Do not modify if unsure about options, GsCore restart required after changes
mastersDesc: Maps to the masters config entry. These users get pm=0, the highest permission level; this is not the group-admin role.
superusersDesc: Maps to the superusers config entry. These users get pm=1, below masters and above group owners/admins.
configSaved: Core config saved successfully, GsCore restart required
languageDesc: Language of GsCore framework logs and system messages (for the deployer); zh-cn = Simplified Chinese, en = English. GsCore restart required after change.
webMaxSessionsDesc: Maps to the web_max_sessions config entry: how many devices/browsers can stay logged in with the same account. 1 = single sign-on (a new login kicks out the oldest session); increase for multi-device access. Login stays valid for 48 hours and survives backend restarts.
